name: software-team-agents
description: T90-T91 — the distributable unit for this framework's `sta` CLI: orchestrator/dist (compiled orchestrator/src) plus templates/ (the framework's own .claude/agents, contracts, workflows, policies, stacks, etc., snapshotted by `npm run build`). This is deliberately a *different* package from orchestrator/package.json, which stays the private dev/test package for building and testing this repo's own orchestrator — this one is what `sta init`/`upgrade` (T92/T95) in a target project actually installs from. `private: true` on purpose: this file makes the package publishable-shaped, it does not itself decide to publish it to a registry.
